entities.summary: Broderick Bernard Jones is an American professional football offensive tackle for the Pittsburgh Steelers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Bulldogs, winning the CFP national championship twice before being selected by the Steelers in the first round of the 2023 NFL draft.
